The David outside is a copy

Palazzo Vecchio, Florence's town hall, overlooks Piazza della Signoria, where a copy of Michelangelo's David stands.

The clock whose bells start the Twelve Grapes

Puerta del Sol's clock marks the eating of the Twelve Grapes at New Year, broadcast live since 31 December 1962.
